name: Memory Express
description: Western Canadian computer and electronics retailer with an online store for PC components, laptops, peripherals and gaming hardware. Its policy pages state shipping within Canada by courier and free in-store pickup at its locations; automated access is challenged by bot protection.
description_es: Minorista canadiense de computadoras y electrónica con tienda en línea de componentes de PC, laptops, periféricos y hardware para juegos. Sus políticas indican envío dentro de Canadá por mensajería y retiro gratis en sus tiendas; el acceso automatizado está limitado por protección contra bots.

ships_to.notes: Shipping within Canada only by courier; northern and remote regions are excluded from standard ground flat rates.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free in-store pickup at its locations, with payment taken in store.

search.notes: Homepage returned 403; automated access looks restricted (challenge).

shopping_notes: Bot protection challenges automated requests; do not attempt to bypass it.
